telescopic-eye: Production pixel-art sprite source for GenVo, two separate states of ONE modular telescopic eye organ, on truly transparent background. Horizontal layout, two equal square cells side by side with a wide clear gap: LEFT an open eye, RIGHT the same eye gently blinked shut. Each component seen directly from above as a small rounded organic bulb with layered sage-green skin socket, a slightly projecting upper ridge, recessed warm amber iris, small near-black pupil and one pale cream glint. Closed version keeps same bulb silhouette and replaces the iris with a natural green lid and narrow dark lid seam. These are dorsal-set animal eyes viewed from a vertical overhead game camera, not a human frontal eye, not a side view, not mechanical lenses. Base/attachment at the exact center of each component; connected skin around it. Crisp chunky pixel clusters designed to survive 18x18 nearest sampling within native32, simple readable irregular contours and limited palette: dark green shadow, muted green skin, light sage skin; protected amber, near black and cream inside eye. Center each state in its half; identical scale and alignment, ample transparent outer padding. No whole creature, no text, no dividers, no ground, no glow, no shadow outside silhouette, no scenery. Two matching animation states only.
raptor-eye: Production pixel-art sprite source for GenVo, two separate states of ONE modular raptor eye organ on truly transparent background. Horizontal layout with two equal square cells side by side and a wide clear gap: LEFT open eye, RIGHT the identical eye during a brief closed blink. View directly from above, vertical overhead game camera; a compact predatory animal's dorsal-set eye anatomy, not a human face or frontal portrait. Low wide tapered sage-green skin socket with a strong sloping upper brow ridge and smaller lower rim; recessed golden yellow iris, small near-black pupil, single tiny cream glint. The closed state retains exact outer socket and brow silhouette but has a sage-green lid and a fine near-black closing seam. Irregular organic contours, strong readable shadow planes, less round and broader than a telescopic eye bulb. Crisp chunky pixel clusters suitable for 20 by 14 nearest sampling within a native32 cell. Dark green shadows, muted green skin and pale sage ridge, protected golden iris, near-black pupil/seam, cream glint. Root solid at center of each component. Equal scale and alignment in both cells with ample transparent padding. No whole animal, no beak, no head, no feathers, no side perspective, no text, no dividers, no background, no glow, no cast shadow. Only these two matching anatomical animation states.
